findings.evidence: grep for `volume_carrier_and_le` across ./code: declaration at GaussBonnet.lean:504 and uses only at :535 (`P.volume_carrier_and_le.2`) and :540 (`sub_nonneg.1 P.volume_carrier_and_le.1`) — no use outside this file.
findings.issue: `volume_carrier_and_le` is public, but it is only the conjunction in which the induction runs; both components are exported separately as `volume_carrier` (:533) and `sum_interiorAngle_le` (:539), and it is not in the module's Main results list. It adds a third, redundant spelling of the main theorem to the API.

findings.evidence: grep for `CompactConvexPolygon` constructions in ./code finds only `eraseLast` (GaussBonnet.lean:175) and the `MulAction` `smul` (Basic.lean:205); no user-facing builder. The needed rotation lemma exists: Geodesic/Orientation.lean:251 `mem_leftHalfPlane_geodesicBetween_of_mem_leftHalfPlane {A B C} (hAB : A ≠ B) (h : C ∈ leftHalfPlane (geodesicBetween A B)) : A ∈ leftHalfPlane (geodesicBetween B C)`.
findings.fix: Expose a constructor, e.g. `def mk₃ {A B C : ℍ} (h : C ∈ leftHalfPlane (geodesicBetween A B)) : CompactConvexPolygon 3` with `vertex := ![A, B, C]`, plus `@[simp]` `vertex_mk₃` lemmas; the two extra conditions follow from two applications of `mem_leftHalfPlane_geodesicBetween_of_mem_leftHalfPlane` and the index cases by `decide` as in `carrier_three`.
findings.issue: The three-vertex API is elimination-only: `carrier_three`, `interiorAngle_three`, `sum_interiorAngle_three` consume a `CompactConvexPolygon 3`, but nothing constructs one. The only exposed introduction is the raw structure constructor, which demands all three counterclockwise conditions (`C` left of `A→B`, `A` left of `B→C`, `B` left of `C→A`) plus the `Fin 3` index bookkeeping, so a consumer cannot instantiate `volume_carrier` on a concrete triangle without redoing that work.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Geometry/Polygon/Basic.lean:29-44: `structure Polygon (P : Type*) (n : ℕ) where vertices : Fin n → P`, `instance : CoeFun (Polygon P n) …`, `def HasNondegenerateEdges (poly : Polygon P n) : Prop := ∀ i, poly i ≠ poly (finRotate n i)` — all declared before the `[Ring R] [AddTorsor V P]` variables at :53, so they apply to `Polygon ℍ n`. This repo already builds on it: SchwarzChristoffel/Polygon/Basic.lean:8 `public import Mathlib.Geometry.Polygon.Basic` and :71-73 `def schwarzChristoffelPolygon … : Polygon ℂ (n + 2) where vertices := …`.
findings.fix: Make it `structure CompactConvexPolygon (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] extends Polygon ℍ n`, drop the `vertex` field in favour of the inherited `vertices` and its coercion (renaming the `vertex_*` lemmas accordingly), and state the edge-nondegeneracy as `toPolygon.HasNondegenerateEdges` (`finRotate n i = i + 1`).
findings.issue: The structure declares its own `vertex : Fin n → ℍ` rather than extending Mathlib's `Polygon ℍ n`, duplicating that structure's `vertices` field and `CoeFun`. The result is two incompatible vertex-list interfaces in the library: `P.vertex i` here versus `poly i` / `poly.vertices i` everywhere else, and Mathlib's polygon vocabulary (`Polygon.HasNondegenerateEdges`, which needs no affine structure and is exactly `vertex_ne_vertex_add_one`) cannot be applied to a `CompactConvexPolygon`. The downstream `Polygon/SidePairing.lean` and `Polygon/LocallyFinite.lean` would inherit the divergence.

summary: The angular-defect-plus-area conjunction that runs the induction is public although both halves are exported separately and it has no use outside the file; the three-vertex bridge has elimination but no introduction, so no consumer can build a polygon; and the structure re-declares a vertex list instead of extending Mathlib's `Polygon ℍ n`, which this repo already uses elsewhere.
